subject: Charter Financial Procedures Article Drafting
overview: The Article VI Subcommittee reviewed and drafted financial procedures for the proposed city charter, focusing on budget timelines, inter-branch collaboration, and auditing requirements. The group decided to refer a proposal concerning City Council budget amendment powers back to the full committee while establishing new requirements for joint budget meetings and digital transparency.

items.title: City Council Budget Amendment Power
items.summary: Referred a request to reconsider granting the City Council power to move money within the budget back to the full Charter Study Committee for further deliberation.

items.title: Annual Joint Budget Meeting
items.summary: Proposed a charter requirement for a joint annual meeting between the Mayor, City Council, and School Committee to review financial forecasts before the formal budget process begins.

items.title: Budget Submission and Message
items.summary: Drafted language requiring the Mayor to submit the operating budget and a descriptive budget message to the City Council at least 30 days before the fiscal year begins.

items.title: Public Hearing and Adoption Protocols
items.summary: Selected draft protocols for public hearing notices and budget adoption timelines modeled on existing language from the Melrose and Pittsfield city charters.

items.title: Online Budget Availability
items.summary: Agreed to include a requirement that all proposed and enacted budget documents remain posted on the city's website throughout the duration of the fiscal year.

items.title: Capital Improvement Program
items.summary: Tabled a decision on the required frequency of Capital Improvement Program submissions to seek technical input from the city's financial department.

items.title: Independent Audit and Procurement
items.summary: Drafted requirements for an annual independent audit and a competitive procurement process for auditing services to be conducted every five years.

items.title: Expenditure Limits and Systems Budgeting
items.summary: Reviewed prohibitions on expenditures exceeding appropriations and discussed a public suggestion to implement unified Enterprise Resource Planning software across city departments.
